_doc: Config for scripts/lint_public_asset_refs.py. See that file's docstring for the disease, the declared limits, and the shrink-only contract on known_missing.
_exclude_rationale: Tests and .d.ts write asset paths that are deliberately fake (fixtures proving a fallback renders, OpenAPI examples). Flagging them would teach people to delete honest tests.
_ignore_rationale: Build output and API routes are never public/ files.
_framework_rationale: Served by the Next.js app/ file convention, absent from public/ BY DESIGN. Each verified live (HTTP 200) on balizero.com 2026-08-07 before being listed here — this list is a measurement, not an assumption.
_known_missing_rationale: REAL broken references, NOT exemptions. Shrink-only: the lint fails on any entry that stops being missing or stops being referenced, so this list cannot quietly outlive its defects. Each entry records what was MEASURED, not what was assumed.
